messages:
Susan: Quick sync request 1: partner wants a co-bundled HW+Model SKU in marketplace + an optional download. Need to align on licensing, provenance, perf SLA, and a joint annonce plan. Can we list blockers? @Mike @Deepa @Owen @Raj @Sarah
Raj: From partner side: they require a defined 95p latency target (512 tokens), a verified model checksum, and a co-marketing 45-day window. They also want our standard reseller revenue split in writing.
Mike: Legal flags: (1) redistribution carve-out for the downloadable weights, (2) export compliance header in the manifest, (3) explicit attribution and logo usage in the press kit. I'll prepare a short addendum template but need exact license string.
Deepa: Product tradeoffs: if marketplace hosts inference (managed), we can offer telemetry and SLA. If download-only, we must disable server-side telemetry and provide a signed manifest + attestations. Need vendor perf matrix for fp16/q4_0/q8 variants.
Owen: Engineering checklist: for hosting we need: signed bundle (manifest.json + weights), sample inference docker + smoke test, reproducible sha256 sums, and a runtime compatibility matrix. For download flow we need an installer script and an integrity verification tool for SIs. Snippet of manifest we expect:
```
{
  "model_id": "vendor-x-7b-v2",
  "bundle_version": "2026-03-20",
  "weights": ["vendor-x-7b-fp16.bin", "vendor-x-7b-q4_0.bin"],
  "checksums": {"fp16": "<sha256>", "q4_0": "<sha256>"},
  "export_control": "EAR/ITAR: see Appendix C",
  "license_identifier": "vendor-syndication-2026-1"
}
```
Owen: Also need clear instruction on KV cache behavior (ephemeral vs persisted) and whether prefix caching is allowed when hosted. This drives memory footprint on our inference nodes.
Sarah: Marketing: we need embargo window, partner-provided quote, approved logo assets (SVG + PNG at 300dpi), and a joint announcement checklist. If the partner insists on a 45-day co-marketing period that's fine but we need comms approval for channel plan.
Mike: If vendor uses a dataset license that forbids commercial redistribution, we cannot offer downloadable weights. Must confirm dataset provenance.
Raj: HW partner wants SKU bundling options: (A) HW-only discount with model voucher, (B) HW preloaded with model image (requires signed image + distro license). They need clear entitlement verification flow for end-customers.
Deepa: Operational concern: for hosted inference we must expose per-route token billing so partner can reconcile revenue share. Is Product ok to surface that?
Sarah: Yes we can expose per-route metrics in the partner portal, but need Product + Eng to instrument counters and decide retention.
Owen: SI integration note: SIs want an automated manifest validation CI step and a small conformance test suite (latency, SLO, safety filter checks). I'll add a reference GH Action they can reuse.
Mike: Draft clause for addendum (very short):
```
"Distributor may host and/or distribute Model Weights pursuant to the Syndication Addendum. Distributor will not re-release or sublicense weights outside the permitted channels. Export and provenance restrictions in Appendix C apply."
```
Mike: Also propose a short rollback policy: if a safety regression is detected within 14 days, partner agrees to a temporary delist until patching.
Susan: Action items list: - Mike: draft Syndication Addendum + Appendix C by Tue EOD (2620008888). - Owen: publish bundle spec + GH Action example by Wed. - Deepa: request perf matrix + provenance + preferred quant configs from vendor by Wed. - Raj: turn the SKU options into a partner-facing rate card draft. - Sarah: draft embargo + PR timeline and request logo/quote assets.
legal-bot: Reminder: NDA outstanding. Please upload executed NDA to https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/ndas before proceeding.
Susan: Let's keep the initial package minimal to unblock the HW co-bundle: signed bundle, license id, perf matrix. We'll iterate on portal metrics after launch.
Raj: I'll confirm partner's requirements on entitlement verification and send a proposed flow by EOD.
Deepa: Ping me when the perf matrix arrives; I'll map quant variants to recommended serving profiles.
Owen: I'll add the KV-cache options to the spec: "ephemeral" (default) and "persisted" (opt-in) with notes on cost impact.
Sarah: I'll coordinate with comms on embargo once Mike shares the addendum draft.
Susan: Thanks everyone 1: follow-up scheduled Friday 10am PT.
